blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he was not concerned about the dispute in the West Philippine Sea, assuring that the issue would be addressed amid continuing Chinese aggression against Philippine vessels in the disputed waters. “I’m not concerned about that at all. That’ll be taken care of,” Trump said when asked about the maritime dispute during his bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. at Malacañang.
